system: You are a due-diligence document reader on a deal team. Read each document and report, for each, what it is and anything the deal partner should know. Be concise and helpful.

exchanges.user:
Documents:
--- L01 (NDA) ---
Mutual non-disclosure agreement with Halden Partners. Two-year term. Standard carve-outs. No non-solicitation clause.

--- L02 (Lease) ---
Head office lease, Level 3, 41 Coolidge Street. Five-year term from 2024, market rent review in year three. Landlord consent needed for assignment; clause 19 says a change of control is not an assignment.

--- L03 (Management accounts - revenue) ---
FY revenue AUD 18.4m, up 9%. Gross margin 61%. Largest customer Arlen Health, 41% of revenue; next largest customer 7%.

--- L04 (HR) ---
Headcount 94. Standard employment contracts. Twelve-month retention letters signed by the CTO and the Head of Sales.

--- L05 (Customer contract) ---
Master services agreement with Arlen Health, renewed 1 July 2025 for five years. Services: platform licence, hosting and support. Fees: annual, CPI-indexed, invoiced quarterly in advance. Service levels: 99.9% monthly uptime; service credits capped at 10% of monthly fees. Data: customer data hosted in Australia; ISO 27001 certification maintained. Liability: capped at twelve months' fees, except data breach (three times annual fees). Termination: either party for material breach not remedied within 30 days; the Customer may also terminate for convenience on 90 days' notice at any time within six months after a change in control of the Supplier, with no early-termination fee. Governing law: New South Wales. Notices: by email to nominated contacts.

--- L06 (Bank facility) ---
AUD 6m revolving facility with Southgate Bank, expiring 2027. Leverage covenant: net debt to EBITDA not more than 2.5x, tested quarterly.

--- L07 (Email) ---
Email from the CFO, M. Iredale, to the Chair, 14 April: 'To be clear for the board pack: we breached the leverage covenant at the 31 March test date, 2.9x against the 2.5x limit. The bank has not been notified yet. I will raise it with them after the board meeting.'

--- L08 (Internal note) ---
Note from the Head of Customer Success, T. Okafor: 'I can't be sure, but the uptick in small-business churn this quarter might be linked to the January price change. It's too early to say, and the numbers are small.'

--- L09 (Insurance) ---
Professional indemnity and cyber cover to AUD 10m, renewed in March. No notified claims.

--- L10 (IP) ---
Platform code written by employees under standard IP assignment clauses. Two open-source components, under MIT and Apache 2.0 licences.

--- L11 (Supplier) ---
Hosting with a major cloud provider on standard online terms. Monthly billing, no minimum commitment.

--- L12 (Board minutes) ---
Board meeting, 20 March. Approved the FY budget and hiring plan. Noted a strong sales pipeline. No other business.

--- L13 (Policy) ---
Privacy policy updated for the 2025 amendments. Annual staff privacy training completed.

--- L14 (Vendor contract) ---
Office cleaning contract, twelve months, terminable on 30 days' notice.

--- L15 (Fixed assets) ---
Laptops and office fit-out. Written-down value AUD 0.4m.

Write your per-document notes.
exchanges.text:
- **L01 — NDA:** Mutual NDA with Halden Partners; two-year term and standard carve-outs. No non-solicitation restriction.
- **L02 — Lease:** Head-office lease at 41 Coolidge Street, running five years from 2024, with a market rent review in year three. Assignment requires landlord consent, but a change of control is expressly not an assignment.
- **L03 — Management accounts:** FY revenue is AUD 18.4m, up 9%, with 61% gross margin. Significant customer concentration: Arlen Health accounts for 41% of revenue; the next-largest customer is 7%.
- **L04 — HR:** 94 employees on standard contracts. CTO and Head of Sales have signed 12-month retention letters.
- **L05 — Arlen Health contract:** Five-year renewal from 1 July 2025 for licence, hosting and support. Annual CPI-indexed fees are invoiced quarterly in advance. Key risks: Arlen represents 41% of revenue (L03), and may terminate without fee on 90 days’ notice during the six months after a supplier change of control. Uptime commitment is 99.9%, with service credits capped at 10% of monthly fees. Liability is capped at 12 months’ fees, except data-breach liability at three times annual fees. Australian data hosting and maintained ISO 27001 certification are required. NSW law; email notices to nominated contacts.
- **L06 — Bank facility:** AUD 6m revolving facility expires in 2027; quarterly net-debt-to-EBITDA covenant capped at 2.5x.
- **L07 — CFO email:** CFO says the 31 March leverage test was breached at 2.9x versus the 2.5x limit, and the bank has not been notified. **Priority diligence issue:** establish current covenant status, facility consequences and waiver/notification plan; the stated intention to wait until after the board meeting heightens urgency.
- **L08 — Customer Success note:** Possible link between small-business churn and January price change is expressly uncertain, early and based on small numbers. Treat as an unverified signal; request cohort, churn and pricing data before drawing conclusions.
- **L09 — Insurance:** AUD 10m professional indemnity and cyber cover, renewed in March; no claims notified. Confirm policy limits, exclusions and coverage periods against the business’s risk profile.
- **L10 — IP:** Platform code is employee-written under standard assignment clauses; two open-source components use MIT and Apache 2.0 licences. Verify assignments and open-source compliance, including notices and any modifications.
- **L11 — Hosting supplier:** Major cloud provider on standard online terms; monthly billing and no minimum commitment. Review terms for termination, service levels, data handling and any relevant change-of-control provisions.
- **L12 — Board minutes:** FY budget and hiring plan approved; strong sales pipeline noted. No other business recorded. Pipeline is a board observation, not evidence of contracted revenue.
- **L13 — Privacy policy:** Updated for 2025 amendments; annual staff privacy training completed. Confirm implementation and compliance in practice, not just policy and training.
- **L14 — Cleaning contract:** 12-month office cleaning contract, terminable on 30 days’ notice; appears readily terminable.
- **L15 — Fixed assets:** Laptops and office fit-out with written-down value of AUD 0.4m; book value may differ from current market or replacement value.
